name: telegram-hook
description: Answer Claude Code's questions, plan approvals and permission prompts from Telegram when you step away: tap an option, Allow, Always allow or Deny, or reply with text, a photo or a file. macOS and Linux desktops.

bot_token.title: Telegram bot token
bot_token.description: Token from @BotFather. Use a bot that nothing else polls (not the official Telegram channel plugin's bot).

chat_id.title: Your Telegram chat ID
chat_id.description: Numeric ID of your private chat with the bot. Only this chat can answer. Leave empty to pair: send the bot a private message and it replies with your ID.

away_delay.title: Away delay (seconds)
away_delay.description: How long the computer must be idle before a prompt is sent to Telegram.

reply_window.title: Reply window (seconds)
reply_window.description: How long a Telegram ping waits for your answer before the normal dialog takes over.

user_name.title: Your name
user_name.description: How Claude is told who answered, as in "<name> replied in Telegram".
